protocol.scope: Main evidence/precision/budget/measurement contract fixed; full data integration and all GPU compatibility still pending

S1.selection: original published ranks 0,1,2, including refs marked unused by OLD official-loader protocol

S2.selection: all actual ordered GT refs; no padding or forced top3

S3.subset_comparison: restrict S1 results to identical predeclared S3 qids; report subset/parent denominators and coverage

image_processing.source_bytes_order: same per condition across models; native processor resizes differ

performance.list: smoke_20.v2 or its semantic D1 subset
performance.P95_claim: descriptive; five repeats of20questions are not100independent questions; no stability guarantee

timing.generate: CUDA sync before/after generate; prefill+decode, excludes CPU preprocess/transfer
timing.end_to_end: per question decode/preprocess/transfer/generate/final boundary; excludes bundle checks/load/warmup/scoring
timing.retrieval: not executed for published candidates; null, not zero
timing.selection: CPU selection duration separately recorded, never added across hardware
timing.memory: process allocator peak separate from device-wide peak; unmeasured device peak=null

protocol.precision_note: BF16 loading/compute policy; official internal FP32 numerical paths may remain. Log actual parameter dtype counts; not an all-operations-BF16 claim.

quality_formula: Each split15*N+2*N_S3; aggregate hardware-work estimate may sum phases, accuracies reported separately by split. S1 subset analysis adds no generation.
